children: From the first launch to Apple Pay, bank notifications, debts, credits, FOP, brokers, investment taxes and your own ChatGPT or Claude. Short and step by step.

Install Dibsly from the App Store and tap «Get started» (the globe at the top changes the language). Dibsly asks for notifications and the AI — both can wait. Used Dibsly before? «Restore your data»: sign in, a backup or a CSV.

«Import your operations»: monobank in one tap, or «A statement or a file» — any bank's statement, a broker's report or another app's export (PDF, CSV or Excel), several if you like. Dibsly works out what the file is and names the accounts itself. No bank? Tap «Start without a bank».

Then Main shows the «Where do we start?» card: its first row is «Add your first expense», and «See an example» shows Dibsly with made-up money. The example never turns on without that button. Once you have data, the card is «What else to set up»: the accounts, a backup and the automation that records spending itself through
An account is optional: you can sign in with Apple, Google or e-mail any time later.
— the big number at the top: your money for everyday life, cards and cash. Savings, investments and an account with Count in balance off are never in it.
The NBU rate is on the right of the On hand row; tapping it opens the converter.
— one tile per currency; the Investments and FOP tiles appear when they are on. Moving money between your accounts is never spending or income.

— Income, Spent and Net; tapping it opens their operations. Below: Activity with drafts, then the sections you turned on: the plan, goals, the calendar, debts, credits. Debts and credits show in short only what needs your attention; the full list opens with All ›.

records an operation (an expense, income or a transfer), a phrase («Say it») or a receipt; «Import operations» and «Connect monobank» (or «Update from monobank») are there too. The gear at the top opens Settings, with a search at the bottom, and the avatar next to it opens Profile.

Tap a tile in the block on Main and Dibsly shows a short film about the feature, with a “Turn on” button. Swipe up for the next film. × hides the block; Settings → Features → “Show on Main” brings it back.

Settings → Automation is one page for four sources: monobank directly, Brokers, Apple Pay and Bank notifications. The Automation row in Settings shows how many of them work, for example «2 of 4 connected». monobank and brokers record operations at once, while Apple Pay and bank notifications put drafts in Activity.
The keypad opens first and can count + − × ÷. Then pick a category: tapping it records the operation at once.

Tap the date at the top to change it: pick the day and tap «Done». A future date isn't counted until it comes. After expense lets you type the balance you see in the bank, and the amount is worked out.
Your past notes are suggested as you type; picking one sets its category too.

A transfer moves money between your own accounts and is never spending. Between currencies, enter what arrived; the rate comes from Currencies. Pick a person instead of an account, and it is a loan or a debt paid back.

In History, tap an operation, change it and tap «Save» at the bottom; × closes without changes. Splitting an expense, repeating it, adding it to another, returning a purchase or duplicating is in «More actions». Hold an operation to change the category, duplicate, select several or delete. Selected operations can go to another category with «Move» or get a new name with «More actions» → «Rename», and the message after it has «Undo».

In an expense's card, «More actions» → «Split by category»: ₴1,000 at a café becomes 600 for food, 250 for drinks and 150 for a hookah, each part counted in its own category. The sum on top stays the whole bill, with lines under it: your part, the categories apart and, with «Split with a person», who owes you what. Tap a line to change it, and one «Save» keeps it all. History shows each part as its own row with ÷. The balance doesn't change, and the bank's later statement still recognises the whole payment. You can split before saving too: in the new expense's card and in an Apple Pay or bank notification draft, where, with Debts on, «Split with a person» for friends is as well.

A tip paid from another card joins the expense: in the tip's card, «More actions» → «Add to expense», and pick the expense. History keeps one row for the whole sum, marked «· 2 payments», and under the sum the expense's card shows «Paid in two payments» with which account paid what. «More actions» → «Separate a payment» makes a part a separate operation again.
Deleted something by mistake? «Undo» in the message after deleting brings back operations, transfers, goals and payments.

In History and Analytics the filter takes several accounts and several categories at once: tick them and tap «Apply». While a filter applies, a line «Filters: …» with «Reset» stands over the search. When nothing is found, Dibsly says why: nothing in this period (then you can search all time) or nothing for these filters (then «Reset filters»).
+ → «Say it»: «coffee 85», «mono 100 groceries», «yesterday cash 1 200 transport» — and it is recorded. What the phone cannot read, the AI finishes (Premium).

Say «Record in Dibsly» to Siri (Siri takes it in English only) or put the «Record in Dibsly» shortcut on the Action button. Step by step: Settings → Features → «Voice entry». While test data is on, the command still records into your real data, and Dibsly says so: «Saved to your real data».
+ → «Receipt»: a photo or up to three screenshots — the items and the total fill in themselves. 10 receipts a month are free, up to 300 with Premium.
In a receipt, tap «Split the receipt» and mark your items, then send your friends the link: each picks their own.

Every Apple Pay payment comes into Dibsly. When its account and category are already known and «Record at once» is on, it is recorded by itself; the rest wait as drafts in Activity: check the amount and category and record it with one tap. Free, with any card.
In Dibsly: Settings → Automation → Apple Pay: turn the switch on and tap «Install automation». The steps and a video are on the same page, under «How to set up the automation».
In Shortcuts, the Automation tab: «Dibsly · Apple Pay» should be on and run immediately, without asking.
Record each card's first payment with its account, and Dibsly remembers it.
A payment in dollars on a hryvnia card is converted at the app's rate; tap the amount to enter what the bank charged. The statement later brings the exact amount.

A purchase with its account, amount and category, with nothing like it recorded yet, records itself, and Dibsly says «Saved ✅»; tap the notification to open the operation and change or delete it. A calendar payment with the same amount is marked paid. The switch is in Settings → Automation → «Record at once» once Apple Pay or bank notifications are on. It is on for new users. The same goes for bank notifications.

A new «Notification» automation from the Wallet app, «Run Immediately». Actions: «Get text» from Subtitle, Body and Title; «Text» with the two texts you got; then Dibsly's «Import Wallet notification»: Notification text: the text, Card: the card's name, «Show When Run» off.
Check that Wallet may show notifications: iOS Settings → Notifications → Wallet. If bank notifications are on too, one purchase still stays one draft.
Notifications from any bank about purchases, top-ups and transfers are read by Dibsly with the AI through one Shortcuts automation and become drafts.
In Dibsly: Settings → Automation → Bank notifications: turn the switch on and tap «Install automation». The steps and a video are on the same page, under «How to set up the automation».
In Shortcuts, open «Dibsly · Bank Notifications» and under «When I receive a notification from» choose your banks' apps: monobank, Privat24, UKRSIB online, KredoBank or any other.
The automation should run immediately, and in «Read bank notification» turn off «Show When Run».
Allow Dibsly's AI when it asks: without it the notifications can't be read.
The first payment of each card asks for its account. A complete draft with its account and category records itself when

«+» on Main → «Connect monobank» (or Settings → Automation → monobank directly), and confirm the access in the mono app. Then Dibsly shows a page like a statement's: «I'll create new accounts» (or «Here's what I'll do» when a card is already in Dibsly) and a card for each account with its type and balance after import. An account in another currency gets the type «Savings»; «Change name or type» on its card changes it. At the top, «History · From the 1st of the month»: tap it to pick another period, then «Add to Dibsly». From then on transactions arrive on their own within a minute. Read-only access, no token, no passwords. Update any time: «+» → «Update from monobank». Settings → Automation → monobank directly opens «monobank connected»: each account's card has «Importing» or «Not importing», where its operations go and «Rename», then a red «Disconnect» follows the cards.
Save a statement in your bank's app: PDF, CSV, XLS or XLSX. «Where to find a statement» in Dibsly shows a video and the steps for your bank.
Share it to Dibsly or tap «+» on Main → «Import operations» (or Settings → Import & export → «Import operations») and pick the file. Dibsly recognises a FOP statement by itself.

Before writing, Dibsly shows what it will do — «I'll create a new account» or «I'll add the new operations» — with the account's card: the number of operations, the period and the balance. If the file could go to several of your accounts, it asks «Where should it go?». Tap «Import», and «Done» shows how many operations were written and to which accounts.

Dibsly reads the statements of monobank, PrivatBank, UKRSIBBANK and KredoBank, and the FOP statements of PrivatBank and UKRSIBBANK, by itself, free. Any other bank is read by the AI: 3 statements in all free, up to 25 a month with Premium. Check the amounts of such a statement.
Importing the same period again adds only new operations, and the balance check compares your balance with the bank's.

Transfers between your accounts are recognised; other cards in the statement show as accounts in «More accounts from the statement», and if a card isn't yours, choose «Not my card». A second card of the same bank becomes an account of its own, named with the card's last digits («Privat hryvnias •1234»), and a credit card's statement turns Credits on with the card's limit. Tap a new account to change its name, icon or pocket. Categories come from your history, your rules and the bank; the rest lands in «Uncategorized».
When recording an expense, open the category and switch to Brands: a tap writes the brand's name and picks your category for it.
Type the beginning of a name in the note and the brand comes once per category you used it with. Hold a brand on the Brands tab for its other categories.
A brand goes where most of your operations with it went, and the note keeps your own way of writing it. One different category once does not change it.
Rename an operation («Heater» instead of «Rozetka»), and the brand stays, with its logo and category.
Settings → Brands: tap a brand and pick a category. It always goes there then, from statements and drafts too, and travels with backups, sync and the CSV export.

Payments you expect: subscriptions, rent, one-off reminders. They don't change the balance until you record or link an expense. Each day shows the logos of what is due, and the month says what goes out and what comes in. A day's total counts debts and credit payments too.
Open a payment: «Record expense» writes it, «Link» attaches an expense you already have. A draft that matches a payment offers «Mark as paid».

A charge from monobank (its sync or a notification) or from a statement marks its payment in the calendar paid when it comes within three days: the same brand from any account and for any amount; the same name on the payment's account within ±10 %; an income for the exact amount. If the amount differs, the next payments take the new one. The “Paid in the calendar” message has Undo. An expense you record by hand you link yourself.

On the day or 1, 3 or 7 days before. «More actions» → «Repeat» in an expense's or income's card creates a new payment. The calendar can be turned off in Settings, section Features; what Dibsly reminds you of is in Settings → Notifications. Tapping a reminder opens its page: the payment, the credit, the FOP or the investment taxes. Reminders show while Dibsly is open too.
Settings, section Features → Plan. Turning it off keeps your plans.
One plan a month in your main currency. Tap a category to set its limit; the page shows what's left and about how much you can spend a day.
When a category has payments from the

this month, «By the calendar …» under it shows their sum. Hold the category → «Use the calendar», and the limit becomes that sum. The limit card in the Plan and Analytics shows the fact «By the calendar», and a new plan sets a limit no lower than the calendar.
The Plan card shows what's left and up to four categories you watch. Orange means 90% is used, red that the limit is exceeded.
In the plan editor tap a category's name: you see each expense of last month and so far this month, so a limit starts from what really went out.
Hold a category for last month's amount or Remove limit; the bin next to the eye removes a limit in one tap, and the eye shows the category on Main. Hide the keypad with its ⌄ key or a swipe down.
Deleted the plan, saved or removed a limit: the message after it has «Undo». Close the plan editor with changes, and Dibsly asks «Changes not saved» with «Save» or «Don't save».
What you save for: a flat, a car, a cushion. The money stays on savings and investment accounts; the goal shows how much of it is already its.
Turn Goals on in Settings, section Features. Then «Goals» on Main → «Add goal»: the amount, the date and the accounts.
«Goals’ order» decides which goal fills first. A goal of the Reserve kind (a cushion) always fills first and stays at the bottom. Deleted a goal by mistake? «Undo» in the message puts it back.
The easiest way is to connect
: Settings → Automation → Brokers. Trades, dividends, deposits and currency exchanges come by themselves, and Investments turn on by themselves with the first connection. Or use a broker's report:

Settings → Features → Investments: the first row is the switch. The first time, a two-page questionnaire opens: the brokers and accounts, then the portfolio currency. An Investments tile appears on Main; it opens your portfolio.
Save your broker's report: for Interactive Brokers it is the Activity Statement, for Freedom Finance the broker report as XLSX or PDF.

Open «Import operations» («+» in Investments or on Main, or Settings → Import & export) and pick the file. Dibsly sorts out buys, sales, dividends with the tax withheld, deposits and currency exchanges; euros go to an «IBKR EUR» account.

A buy, a sale or a dividend can be recorded by hand too, and a broker's report added from the same place: «+» on the portfolio's page. After recording Dibsly says «Recorded: …», after deleting «Deleted: …», and both messages have «Undo».
In a position's card, under «Total P&L», you see what it is made of: the price, dividends and fees, and the sales when part was sold.

On the portfolio's page, the «Strategy» card → «Edit»: split the portfolio into blocks or single tickers with «from» and «to» shares, and Dibsly shows what to buy. The blocks sit under «Allocation». A saved or deleted block comes back with «Undo» in the message.

The people icon at the top of the portfolio shares your investments with those you share accounts with. The menu in the title switches between «My portfolio», the other person's portfolio and «Portfolio together». Nothing can be recorded in someone else's portfolio, so it has no «+».
On an investment account's page, the ⇄ button at the top moves the operations you choose to another investment account of yours in the same currency. The message «Moved … operations» has «Undo».

Connect it once, and new trades, dividends with their tax, commissions, deposits and currency exchanges arrive by themselves once a day, when you open Investments, in every currency. While connecting, Dibsly also loads the whole history IBKR keeps (usually this year and the four before), and later from any day: «Load the history from…» on the connection page. Steps 1–3 are easiest on a computer.
In IBKR's Client Portal: Performance & Reports → Flex Queries → Activity Flex Query → «+».
Add the sections Trades (Execution), Cash Transactions, Open Positions and Cash Report, all fields in each. Format XML, period Last 365 Calendar Days. Save it and note its number (Query ID).
On the same page, the gear of Flex Web Service Configuration: tick Flex Web Service Status and tap Save — a Current Token appears. Copy it.
In Dibsly: Settings → Automation → Brokers (or Investments → «+» → «Connect a broker») → Interactive Brokers. Paste the token and the query number → «Connect».

Dollars go to your Interactive dollar account, euros to the euro one; if there is no such account, Dibsly makes it. Deposits and currency conversions come too; what you already recorded as a transfer is not doubled. Update any time: «+» → «Update from the broker»; with two brokers connected it has a row for each, and each one updates on its own.
Such an operation's card says «Automatically from Interactive Brokers». If a broker stops accepting the key, Investments shows «… no longer accepts the key» with «Connect again».
It cannot trade, withdraw money or change the account's settings — that is how IBKR's Flex Web Service works.
The token stays on your device.
It sits in the device's Keychain and goes only to IBKR; it never reaches Dibsly's server.
We don't keep the account number.
Dibsly takes only its last 4 digits from the report, to tell operations apart.
«Disconnect» in Dibsly erases the token from the device at once; the operations stay. You can also switch Flex Web Service off or issue a new token in IBKR.
IBKR sets how long it lasts.
A token lasts up to a year; when it ends, Dibsly asks for a new one.
The same for Freedom24: one key, and new trades, dividends with their tax, commissions, deposits and currency exchanges come by themselves. Steps 1–4 are easiest on a computer.
On a computer, sign in to Freedom24 and open the API key page:
Leave the key's validity «Perpetual» and tap «Create a new key pair».
Freedom asks to open a security session: in the Freedom24 app on your phone open «Menu» → the icon at the top right and scan the QR code on the screen.
Copy the public key (32 characters). The private one isn't needed — don't paste it anywhere.
In Dibsly: Settings → Automation → Brokers (or Investments → «+» → «Connect a broker») → Freedom Finance. Paste the e-mail you sign in to Freedom24 with and the public key → «Connect».
Currencies go to your Freedom accounts just as with Interactive, and transfers you already recorded are not doubled. Update any time: «+» → «Update from the broker».
The public key only opens the report.
It cannot trade or withdraw money — that takes the private key, which Dibsly never asks for.
The key stays on your device.
It sits in the device's Keychain and goes only to Freedom24; it never reaches Dibsly's server.
«Disconnect» in Dibsly erases the key from the device at once; to close the access for good, delete the key pair on the same Freedom24 page.
You choose how long it lasts.
When you create the key in Freedom24: an empty field means no expiry.
What to pay in Ukraine on dividends and sales at foreign brokers, and what goes into the declaration. Free.
Investments → the «Taxes for 2026» tile. The taxes page shows each year apart.

The first time, Dibsly asks where your brokers are: for a foreign one Dibsly counts the taxes; a Ukrainian one withholds them itself, so Dibsly leaves it out. The US tax authority's certificate and the loss from past years go in «Tax settings».
Paid? Record the expense in the «Investment taxes» category and Dibsly finds the payment itself. Filed the declaration? «Filed?» → «Filed».

Every dividend and sale in hryvnias at the NBU rate of its day. Dividends: PIT 9 % and the military levy 5 %; the tax withheld abroad reduces PIT only with the US tax authority's certificate. Sales: 18 % and 5 % of the profit in hryvnias — the proceeds at the sale day's rate less the purchase at the purchase day's rate and the commissions. A loss is carried to the next years.

Dividends go to line 10.10, investment profit to line 10.8 and annex Ф1; the same place shows how much PIT and military levy to pay. The declaration is due by 1 May, the payment by 1 August; Dibsly reminds you on 24 April and 24 July. Tapping the reminder opens «Taxes», and you can switch these reminders off in Settings → «Notifications» → «Investment taxes».
On Investments, under the profit — «After taxes, if sold today»: what would be left if you sold everything now. And the «Investment taxes» category also gathers every tax a broker withheld.
With Premium the same page is on
It's a calculation for the declaration, not tax advice: Dibsly doesn't pay taxes or file the declaration. Check the figures in the tax service's online office.

Who owes whom and how much. Lent, borrowed or paid back is a transfer between your account and the person, so it is neither an expense nor an income. Dibsly only records it: you move the money yourself.

First turn on «Debts» in Settings → Features: the Debts block appears on Main. Record a debt there or with + → Operation → Transfer: under «To», pick a person in the «Lend» row (under «From» it is «Borrow»). The card shows what the person owes after this transfer. A loan, a payback or a debt let go ends with the message «Saved to debts», and «Undo» in it removes what was just recorded.

In an expense's card, «More actions» → «Split with a person»: your part stays an expense, your friends' parts become debts, and under the sum you see who owes you what. In a receipt, tap «Split the receipt» and «I paid for the whole receipt».
On the person's page, «Paid back» or «Pay back». Money from them in a bank notification is suggested as a return; a saved income becomes one with «It is a debt paid back» in its card.

Until a friend accepts the debt, «Share» sends them its link: a friend with Dibsly accepts it in their app, and every record either of you makes reaches the other to confirm. Then «Remind» sends them a notification. You both need a Dibsly account — a free one is enough.
«Paid back» → «Money did not come to an account»: the debt closes and the sum goes to Gifts in your expenses.
The ⋯ menu on the person's page sets or removes the pay-back date, renames the debt or sends it to the archive. Each change says what was done and has «Undo».
A loan, a mortgage, a purchase in instalments, a microloan or a card's limit: what's left, the next payment and the overpayment.
Turn on «Credits» in Settings, section Features: the Credits block appears at the bottom of Main. «All ›» in it → «+» → the kind. A mortgage or an old loan is entered by what is left on a day.

In a saved expense's card, «More actions» → «Bought in instalments»: the purchase stays whole in Analytics, the bank's part comes back to the card, and each month's part pays off the «Purchase in instalments» in Credits.

On a credit's page, «Pay» splits the payment into the body and interest (an expense in «Interest and fees»). «Early» shows what a shorter term or a lower payment saves. A payment from a statement: in its card, «More actions» → «This is a credit payment».

«On hand» shows only your own money, and the card's sum has «… credit left» beside it. In «Credit card limit», enter from your bank's tariffs when the grace period ends («the month's end», as at monobank, or «a set day» of the next month, like the 25th at PrivatBank), the interest per month and the minimum payment. That day, with what to pay back, goes into the calendar, onto Main and into the widget, with a reminder three days before. Dibsly shows the minimum payment and, once the grace period is over, what a month of the debt costs. Credit payments are in the calendar too, with reminders three days before and on the day. Tapping a reminder opens the credit itself, or a credit card's account.
A payment, a new credit, changed terms and a card's limit end with a message («Payment saved», «Credit added», «Terms saved», «Limit saved»), and it has «Undo».
Dibsly only records the payments — it never moves the bank's money.
For a 3rd-group FOP (5%, no VAT): income, the single tax, the military levy and ESV by quarter, deadlines and payment details. Free.

Settings → Features → FOP: the first row is the switch. The first time you turn it on, the «FOP questionnaire» opens on two pages: who pays ESV and where you are registered, then the FOP accounts and the operations you already have. The rest you change in «FOP settings», and «Open the FOP page» takes you to the taxes and deadlines.

Income on a FOP account counts at the NBU rate of the day it arrived. A refund or your own transfer: turn off «FOP income» in the operation's card, or hold it on the FOP page → «Not FOP income». Tapping an income opens its operation.
The FOP page shows the single tax, the military levy and ESV by quarter, how much is due and by when. The deadlines are in the calendar with reminders.

«Show payment details» under the deadlines opens the amounts and the tax service's details for your community — every field copies with a tap. The tax's card in the calendar has «Show payment details» too, and the line «By … your accounts need» counts the FOP taxes as well.

Hours, rate and your own conditions — and how much should arrive each month. You type the hours each month on the FOP page: with an hourly rate every month in «Incomes» opens a payout, so the hours can go in before the first payout arrives.
Every mark says what it did and has «Undo»: «Not counting it as FOP income», «Filed», «Mark paid», a payment recorded from the calendar and an account taken out of FOP.
Dibsly doesn't pay taxes or file returns — you do. Check the figures and details against the tax service's e-cabinet, especially before your first payment.
A chat about your money right in the app: ask in words, Dibsly answers in your own figures.
On Main the chat opens with the button above «+»; on other pages, with the orange tab on the right. The chat knows which page you opened it from.

It counts spending, finds operations, records («record coffee 85»), moves them to categories, sets limits and imports a statement with 📎. Nothing is saved until you tap «Save». After an answer Dibsly suggests what to ask next.

Ask about the app itself too: «how do trends in Analytics work?», «how are investment taxes counted?» — Dibsly answers from its own guide, so it explains how the app really works. Such a question goes to the AI and is counted like the others.
«Where do I turn on FOP?» or «how do I hide the amounts» — Dibsly answers itself from the help, without the AI and not counted. «Ask the AI» under such an answer asks the AI.

20 questions to the AI a month are free, up to 40 a day with Premium. The first time, Dibsly shows what goes to the AI and asks for your permission; to turn the chat on or off — Settings → Features → «AI in Dibsly» → «Ask Dibsly». «Delete all chats» is there too.

«+» at the top of the chat starts a new one, and the earlier one goes to «Chats» (the clock button next to «+»): the newest first, a tap opens a chat to go on with it. To delete one, use the bin on the right or hold it → «Delete»; «Undo» in the message brings it back. Chats are kept on this device only, up to the 50 latest.

The avatar on Main, next to the gear, opens Profile: sign in with Apple, Google or e-mail. One address is one account: Google, Apple or «Create an account» with an address that already has Dibsly sign in to that account, and «Forgot your password?» adds a password to a Google or Apple account too. Without an account everything works on one device.

Profile → «Ways to sign in»: Apple, Google and e-mail with a password sign in to the same account. Google and the password have «Remove» on the right, but the last way in never does: at least one always stays. A new password is typed twice, the second field is «Repeat the password».
While test data is on, you can't sign in, because test data never reaches an account. «Turn off test data» is right in Profile.
With Premium your data is the same on all your iPhones, iPads, your Mac and on my.dibslyapp.com.
67 animated Dibsly. They open as you set things up (accounts, a backup, automation) and keep good habits, and there are memes, secrets and holidays too. Free.
The avatar on Main → «My Dibsly»: your level, «Next» — whom to open next, and the sections Setup, Habits, Memes, Secrets and Holidays. Tap a closed Dibsly to see what opens it.
arrives as a toast with confetti right on the screen where you opened it; «View» shows its page.
On a Dibsly's page, «Make it my avatar», and it appears as the avatar on Main instead of your photo. «Back to the photo» undoes it.
— a 9:16 picture of your Dibsly for Stories or a messenger.
With sync, the Dibsly you opened and your avatar are the same on all your iPhones and iPads.

The same Dibsly: install it from the App Store on your iPad and sign in to the same account — with sync the data is the same as on your iPhone. Premium from the same Apple Account works on the iPad too.

A sidebar on the left: Main, History, Analytics and Main's pages. Main in two columns, tiles and charts across the screen. A bar at the bottom: type “coffee 85” and press Return to record it, or a question to open the chat with Dibsly; the microphone, the camera and “+” beside it. Upright or in Split View you get the tabs at the bottom, as on iPhone.
⌘N a new expense, ⇧⌘N an income, ⌘F search History, ⌘1–⌘3 Main, History, Analytics. Hold ⌘ and the iPad lists them.
Apple Pay and bank notifications are set up on the iPhone, where payments and banks' notifications arrive. With sync those operations are on the iPad at once.

Dibsly for Mac: install it from the App Store on your Mac and sign in to your Dibsly account — everything you recorded on the iPhone is there, and every change reaches the iPhone at once. The Mac comes with Dibsly Premium: a subscription from the iPhone works here too, or take it on the Mac's welcome page.

A sidebar as on my.dibslyapp.com: Main, History, Analytics, Accounts, Debts, Credits, the Plan, the Calendar, Goals, Investments, Taxes and FOP, then Categories, Brands, Sharing, Devices and AI, the profile and Settings. Forms and an operation's details open as a panel on the right.

Drag a bank's PDF, Excel or CSV onto the window: Dibsly reads it and shows what is new before it saves anything. Amounts are typed on the keyboard, «Sections» in the menu bar opens any page, ⌘[ goes back.
Apple Pay and bank notifications through Shortcuts and the widgets are the iPhone's and the iPad's; with sync what they record is on the Mac at once.

When the account has nothing yet, the Mac shows «Start on your iPhone» as the page's title. Open Dibsly on your iPhone and sign in to the same account, and the Mac picks the data up by itself. The same page has «Check again» and «Use another account».

On hand — the total, the rates, the credit available, your accounts and the Savings, Investments and FOP tiles, as on Main. Next payment — the nearest payments from the calendar, a credit card's grace period end among them. Quick entry — an expense, voice or a receipt in one tap. On the Lock Screen — On hand and a “+” for an expense. Free, on iPhone and iPad.
Touch and hold an empty spot on the Home Screen → Edit → Add Widget → Dibsly, and pick a size. On the Lock Screen: touch and hold → Customize → Lock Screen → the widgets area → Dibsly.

Hide amounts hides them in the widgets too, and a locked screen keeps them hidden. A widget shows what Dibsly saved for it on your device — nothing goes out. It updates when you open Dibsly; the total and the accounts also after a sync or a monobank operation in the background.
Settings → Preferences → App icon: System (light on a light Home Screen and dark on a dark one), Dark or Light. iOS shows its own message that the icon changed.
Sign in to your Dibsly account: the avatar on Main → Apple, Google or e-mail.
The avatar on Main → «Sharing» → «Invite a person» and send the link. Each such invitation starts a new group. A link is for one person: it works once, for 7 days.

The other person opens it on an iPhone or iPad with Dibsly and taps «Join». To share an account, tap «Make an account shared» on the group's page, or open the account's card (Settings → Accounts) → «Make shared». With several groups Dibsly asks who it is «Together with».
Shared accounts and goals: each sees their own and the shared. One member's Premium is enough.

«Sharing» is a list, «Who you keep accounts with», with a row for each person or group. Each person sees only the accounts you make shared with them. A group's page shows its people, unused invitations and shared accounts, and «Make an account shared», «Invite someone else to these accounts» and «Leave sharing with …».
Until the person accepts an invitation, it has a page of its own with «Send again» and «Cancel invitation».
When everyone but one person has left a group, the group ends: its shared accounts become that person's own, with all their history, and they get a notification.
On a shared account's page, «Split» takes each part to its owner's account. If your account went to the archive when it became shared, it comes back from the archive.
Dibsly tells you when someone joins or leaves a group and when a new shared account appears in it.

Each year apart: the taxes on dividends and sales, what is already paid and with what, what is left and the declaration's lines. The «paid» and «filed» marks and the tax settings are the same as in the app.
In History open an expense → «Split by category», as in the app.

Ask in words: «how much did I spend on cafés this month?», «here is a statement, add it», «how much tax do I owe on last year's dividends?» — the assistant sees investment taxes too, with the same figures as the app. The assistant writes changes only after your «yes», and each can be undone in the AI journal on the website.
All connections are in the app: the avatar on Main → «Devices and AI». You can remove them there.

Dibsly imports a Monefy CSV and its own CSV. In Monefy export your data as CSV, then in Dibsly open «Import operations» and pick the file. Accounts, categories, currencies and transfers come over, and before saving Dibsly shows how many operations are new and which of the file's accounts and categories it already has or will add. On the first launch it's the «A statement or a file» tile.

Export your data as CSV or Excel and pick the file in «Import operations». Dibsly's AI works out from a sample of rows where the date, amount, category and account are, and Dibsly reads every row on your device. Before saving you see what will be added and how many rows were left out. This import only adds operations and never replaces anything, and the same file a second time doubles nothing.
A Dibsly export can also replace all your data («Replace all data with this file») — then a safety copy is made first. Files from Monefy and other apps only add.
Settings → Backup & recovery: choose an iCloud Drive folder or connect Google Drive, make up a recovery password and turn on automatic backups.
Keep the password in a password manager: without it a backup can't be opened, and nobody, Dibsly included, can recover it.
Automatic backups run daily or weekly, usually at night; the last five are kept, manual ones are never deleted.

«Open a backup file» restores any .dibslybackup. On a new iPhone or iPad, tap «Restore your data» on Dibsly's first screen, or just sign in if you have sync (Premium). A safety copy of the current data is made first.
A backup holds everything, drafts and most settings included. A CSV holds operations, accounts, plans and the calendar, but no drafts or settings.

Settings → Data health and test data → «Delete all data». Dibsly first keeps a safety copy on this device and leaves your iCloud Drive and Google Drive backups alone. When you are signed in, the button isn't there — see below.

The avatar on Main → «Delete account and all data»: the server deletes everything in the account and this device is erased. «Save a copy first» makes a backup. After deleting, Dibsly starts again from the first launch. Deleting doesn't cancel Premium — cancel it in iOS Settings.

The avatar on Main → «Sign out». With sync or shared accounts your data stays in the account, the device is erased and Dibsly starts again from the first launch. Without them the data stays on the device, as without an account.

Without an account your records stay only on this device and in your own backups. monobank, PrivatBank, UKRSIBBANK and KredoBank statements are read here; another bank's statement or another app's export is read by the AI, only with your permission.

An account and sync (Premium) keep your data on Dibsly's server. The AI works only with your consent: what an answer needs goes to OpenAI through Dibsly's server. Also NBU rates, investment quotes, monobank, connected brokers (straight from your device, the key kept only in its Keychain), your backups in iCloud or Google Drive, and anonymous usage statistics you can turn off in Preferences.
«Hide amounts» shows •••• instead of sums, and App Lock asks for Face ID when you come back. Notifications still show amounts — hide previews in iOS Settings.
